description: The monthly payment on a mortgage, repayment or interest-only, the total paid and the total interest, with what's still owed year by year. Use for 'what's the monthly payment on £250k at 4.5% over 25 years'.

annualRatePct.description: The yearly interest rate, e.g. 4.5 for 4.5%.

interestOnly.description: Interest-only: pay just the interest each month and the amount borrowed at the end. Defaults to false.

termYears.description: The mortgage term in years, up to 50.

name: calculate_mortgage_repayments
title: Mortgage repayments
